title: John Lennon gives Yoko Ono a white Steinway piano | 1971
content:
John Lennon gave Yoko Ono a white Steinway & Sons baby grand piano on 18 February 1971.

The Steinway ‘O’ Grand, 419-51, was a present for Ono’s 38th birthday. It was sprayed in a dull white finish, and cost £1,891.

Lennon had arranged for a plaque to be above the piano keyboard which read:

This morning
A White Piano
For Yoko
From John with love 18.2.1971

Lennon also gave Ono a piano hammer with the message: “One Note for Yoko, J.L. 71”

When Tariq Ali and Robin Blackburn visited Tittenhurst Park on 21 January to interview the couple for Red Mole magazine, Lennon and Ono’s assistant Dan Richter took Polaroid pictures of them. One of the pictures had a handwritten note on the back, which read: “Power to Yoko! Peace to Yoko! Love to Yoko! From John Feb 18 71. John and Yoko Forever!” The photograph is likely to have been another part of Ono’s birthday gifts.

The white Steinway piano is best known for featuring in the ‘Imagine’ promotional video.

Page last updated: 26 February 2026
